local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local alive=false
local dead=false
local expectedHealth=16.599990844726562
local restored=false
return {{engineHandlers={{
onSave=function()
 local health=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 print('Sewer death course checkpoint health='..health)
 return {{health=health}}
end,
onLoad=function(data)
 restored=data and data.health~=nil
 expectedHealth=(data and data.health) or 16.599990844726562
 alive=false dead=false
end,
onFrame=function(dt)
 local health=Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current
 if not alive and health>0 then
  assert(math.abs(health-expectedHealth)<0.001,'Checkpoint health not restored')
  local equipped=0
  for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
   if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159829) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then equipped=equipped+1 end
  end
  assert(equipped==3,'Checkpoint equipment not restored')
  alive=true print('Sewer death course '..(restored and 'reloaded' or 'initial')..' checkpoint health='..health)
 end
 if not dead and Actor.isDead(self) then dead=true print('Sewer death course Player dead') end
end}}}}
